One thing to weigh beyond looks. Preflight lights a button when you press it, and dims a whole bay when its pad is asleep. It does that by recolouring the shape it drew — and SDL's colour modulation can only ever darken an image, never brighten or recolour it. A flat single-colour set can be tinted to each player's colour; a set with its own baked-in fills will always look the same regardless of state, so pressing a button would have to be shown some other way.
